quick.title: Quick moves
coach.findJob: Welcome to 2026. You win by hitting four goals: wealth, wellbeing, career and skills. The basement is free, but nothing else is, so you need an income. First get to {{location}}: click it on the board, or press Go.
coach.apply: Pick a job. Each row shows the pay and how likely an AI is to take your job. Better jobs unlock as you build skills.
coach.goWork: Hired! Now get to {{location}} for your first shift.
coach.work: Tap Work full shift. Wages land at the end of every shift, not at the end of the week.
coach.paid: That's your first paycheck. The week panel tracks food and rent: eat something, then end the week when you're done.

replay.title: Replay a game
replay.intro: Load a game from `pnpm sim trace <seed> --replay game.json`, or a save file, and step through it on the board.
replay.badFile: That isn't a game file: it needs a setup and an action log.
replay.stopped: Stopped at action {{index}}: it isn't legal here ({{code}}).
about.title: About & privacy
about.privacy.account: You don't need an account to play.
about.privacy.saves: Saves and settings are stored in this browser only. Nothing about your game is sent anywhere.
about.privacy.analytics: Anonymous play data (weeks played, goals reached, where people quit) is only sent if you turn on "Share anonymous play data" in Settings. It never includes your name or your saves.
about.privacy.hosting: The site is hosted on Cloudflare, which counts page visits without cookies.
about.privacy.delete: Delete a save from the title screen, or clear this site's data in your browser to remove everything.
about.help.intro: Fast Lane is satire. If real debt, rent or money stress is getting heavy, these free services can help:

about.help.ca: Canada: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada
about.credits.made: Fast Lane 2026 is an original life-sim built with React, PixiJS and a lot of spreadsheets.
about.credits.art: Art was generated with AI image tools from the project's own style guide, then reviewed and edited by hand.
about.credits.ip: Inspired by Jones in the Fast Lane (1990). Not affiliated with or endorsed by its rights holders. All names and art here are original.
